question: The circumference of the two circles is 264 cm and 396 cm respectively. What is the difference between their radii?
solution:
**Given:**

Circumference of first circle (C₁) = 264 cm

Circumference of second circle (C₂) = 396 cm 

**Formula used:**

Circumference = 2πr

Difference in radius, r₂ - r₁ = {C₂ over 2π} - {C₁ over 2π}

**Calculation:**

r2 - r1 = {1over 2​​π} (C2 - C1)

⇒ {1over 2​​π}(396 - 264) cm 

⇒ (0.159 × 132) cm

⇒ 20.99 cm

~ 21 cm 

**∴ The difference between the radii of two circles is 21 cm.**
